slides.headline: AI is quietly stealing your land.
slides.body: Everyone thinks AI will save real estate. Nobody realizes it's aggressively absorbing the land supply you need to build housing.

slides.headline: A silent war is happening right now.
slides.body: A data center developer and a multifamily developer show up to the exact same 20-acre plot of land. The data center offers 3x the price in cash.

slides.headline: The brutal math.
slides.body: A 400-unit apartment complex generates roughly $8M a year. A single hyperscale data center block generates $300M a year on a 15-year lease.

slides.headline: It's not a fair fight.
slides.body: As data centers eat the land supply, housing remains permanently constrained. Which means the intrinsic value of every existing residential unit just went up.

slides.headline: You are sitting on a goldmine.
slides.body: But you can't unlock that value if your operations are bleeding cash. You don't need more land to scale. You need autonomous operations.

slides.headline: The AI Land War is a massive structural tailwind.
slides.body: Are you positioned to capture it, or are you still approving invoices in an email thread? Switch to Aethera.
